crossChapterBoundaries: Chapter 1 already tested common fibular versus L5 localization and preganglionic/postganglionic SNAP principles. Here those principles support new management or differential decisions rather than repeat the same MCQs.
Chapter 10 covers NMJ and muscle disease. Their features appear only as clinically relevant neuropathy distractors or emergency mimics here.
Myelopathy, spinal compression and cauda equina are addressed in Chapter 11; urgent exclusion remains explicit when relevant.
Toxicology, systemic vasculitis and plasma-cell disease will have disease-specific chapters; the present items test neuropathy recognition and immediate diagnostic/treatment implications.
requiredFinalReview: Verify EAN/PNS GBS 2023 and CIDP 2021 criteria, time windows, doses and exceptions against original documents.
Check current CIDP FcRn and ATTR treatment labels, formulation differences and evidence limits.
Avoid conflating one abnormal nerve, low CMAP-related slowing, entrapment or a CSF protein result with definite CIDP.
Review all options for realistic clinical competition and all explanations for standalone usefulness.
Validate completed JSON, install additively, compare runtime readback and commit/push scoped installation changes.
